_doc: The library clips (issue #529; tools/blender/library_motion.py, picks in tools/blender/library_picks.json): each move's clip, where it came from, its licence, its length and whether it loops. HumanBody plays them through LibraryMotion when Settings.library_motion is on.

idle.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (B. Hahne's BVH conversion): 77_02.bvh
idle.licence: CMU: free for research and commercial use
idle.why: 77_02, standing: the trunk upright and the arms hanging (111_28 leans back with the hands clasped, 140_06 leans forward)

walk.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (B. Hahne's BVH conversion): 08_01.bvh
walk.licence: CMU: free for research and commercial use
walk.why: the planted foot stays put on our men: 0.11 m/s of skate at 1.3 m/s (the old gait 1.04)

run.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (B. Hahne's BVH conversion): 09_01.bvh

run.why: half the old run's skate (1.07 vs 2.24 m/s); the planted foot still drifts (needs foot IK)
